acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in Top20 mode.
alkylation reagent: static modifications were carbamidomethylated cysteine (+57.0215) and oxidized methionine (+15.9949)
cleavage agent: prior to in-gel trypsin proteolysis, as described in Hartmann et al..
instrument: coupled to a Q-Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: confirming that LC-MS/MS with label-free quantitation can be applied to monitor SARS-CoV-2 infection kinetics.
